title: Hardcode admin principal in frontend and remove blocking admin checks

requirements.summary: Update the frontend useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook to hardcode the admin Principal and ensure immediate admin access
acceptanceCriteria: The hardcoded admin Principal in `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout` matches the one in the backend.
When logged in as the hardcoded admin, the Admin nav link appears immediately.
The admin dashboard loads without a permission error when accessed by the hardcoded admin.

file_operations.description: Replace the hardcoded admin principal constant with the user's actual Principal ID. Update the hook logic to immediately return admin status when the authenticated caller matches the hardcoded Principal, bypassing the timeout and backend verification for that specific user. Ensure the hook still attempts backend verification for non-hardcoded principals. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the Navigation component to use the result from useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout and ensure the Admin link renders immediately when the hardcoded admin Principal is authenticated, without waiting for backend verification. Remove any timeout-based conditional rendering for the hardcoded admin.

Update the AdminDashboard page to check admin status using useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout and grant immediate access when the hardcoded admin Principal is authenticated. Remove any blocking guards or permission checks that would prevent the hardcoded admin from seeing the dashboard content.
